interpretation: Vioxx is IFE-scenario. Own scenario (IFE) shows FA up (0.839->0.911) and DEF/EWEF collapse fully to 0 -- matches the aspirin/rosiglitazone own-scenario-collapses pattern, NOT the HRT outlier. 3 of 4 concepts now show this pattern; HRT remains the exception. Despite having by far the thinnest protected subspace (rank 1, vs 6-8 for the others), Vioxx's effect size is comparable to the others -- protected-subspace thinness didn't obviously produce a weaker or stronger effect here.
